author: PokerFace
body:
Hi.

I was browsing on OCN forums even though I don't play there and I saw an Event Coordinator rank as well as an Official rank. I think an Event Coordinator rank would be good for people who want to play during the tournament while creating it as well. Not only will this speed up the set-up of tournaments, but it will also give a wider range of ideas. This job would be more about organization and how much time you are willing to spend with spreadsheets and such. Development would be faster and perhaps after every tournament, there would only be a 1 month break between each tournament.

Comment below please.

replies.author: PokerFace
replies.body:
Yeah but that's the thing, I'm suggesting a differentiation. Maybe this "Advisor" rank could become "Official" and Official becomes "Event Coordinator".

An Event Coordinator can be an Official as well if they please to do so.

replies.body:
Event Coordinators basically can organize the event meaning the dates, rules, etc.. and make the official decisions in-game as well. 

Officials can be the "main guy" making the decisions during the game.
